serp_refs: Marketplace pattern: fantasy dragon rugs are commonly searched with 3D illusion, library, bookshelf, round rug and reading nook modifiers.
Buyer language pattern: teacher classroom mats use personalized name, welcome to classroom, colorful dinosaurs and back to school wording.
Decor pattern: flamingo rugs are searched with tropical, pink bird, floral, patio, living room and non slip memory foam terms.
keyword_evidence: Use long-tail descriptive keywords that combine subject, shape, room and personalization where visible: 3D dragon round rug, dragon library rug, dragon bookshelf rug, personalized classroom doormat, flamingo area rug, tropical flamingo rug and non slip backing.
buyer_summary: B050 buyers are mainly fantasy readers/home decorators, teachers preparing a classroom doorway, and tropical decor shoppers. They care about the printed design, room fit, non slip backing, size options, cleanability and whether personalization looks intentional rather than generic.
purchase_concerns: Avoid overpromising true 3D depth; describe as 3D illusion/effect artwork. Mention non slip/low pile only where the evidence supports it. For classroom doormat, keep teacher name personalization front and center. For flamingo, treat it as an area rug rather than a small doormat because the evidence shows room-size rugs.
